messages:
Lucia: small life update—im officially promoted to Lead Designer and were also expecting a baby in September! :tada::baby: totally overwhelmed but so excited. thinking a tiny office get-together Thurs 4pm for a quick toast and dairy-free snacks (im lactose-intolerant).
Ben: OMG congrats lucia!! double celebration :tada: ill bring savory pastries (dairy-free option).
Aisha: absolute best news!!! ill make a nut-free lemon tart (dairy-free sub). happy to drop it by at 3:45.
Kavi: big congrats! want me to bring sparkling water and some mocktail mixers? also happy to help set up signs and a small banner.
Lucia: drinks and banner would be amazing, thank you. trying to keep it low-key  maybe 15 minutes.
People Ops: congrats lucia! we can circulate a digital card and order a small bouquet. Reminder: please label allergens on shared food and tidy common areas after. DM People Ops by Wed if you want us to order anything.
Ben: should we tentatively block 4-4:20 on calendars so teams know?
Lucia: good idea, ill create a short event and mark it "quick congrats for lucia".
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Quick congrats for Lucia (promotion + baby)" Thu Aug 18 16:00-16:20 (Community Kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Aisha: dropping tart at 3:45, labeling everything.
Kavi: mocktail setup 3:50, banner + cleanup volunteer.
Lucia: thank you everyone  im so grateful. if youd like to add a note for the card, DM me or add to the calendar comments. promise not to bring baby name suggestions yet :joy:
